metadata.case_name: CHEUNG MAN FAI v. TO YU BUN AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: He was diagnosed as having Adjustment Disorder with depressed mood.
source: He was diagnosed as having Adjustment Disorder with depressed mood.

injuries.description: He had suffered what is commonly called a whiplash injury to the neck.
source: He had suffered what is commonly called a whiplash injury to the neck.
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain, stiffness or tenderness only

injuries.description: A CT Scan taken on 11 October 2000 of his cervical spine showed no cervical fracture but slight bulging of the intervertebral disc at C4/5 and C5/6 without significant narrowing of the spinal canal.
source: A CT Scan taken on 11 October 2000 of his cervical spine showed no cervical fracture but slight bulging of the intervertebral disc at C4/5 and C5/6 without significant narrowing of the spinal canal.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the neck

injuries.description: complaining of neck pain and left upper limb paresis
source: On 9 October 2000, the plaintiff was referred to the Orthopaedic Clinic of Caritas Medical Centre complaining of neck pain and left upper limb paresis.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of cervical spine

manifestations.description: he experienced pain over the right side of his forehead and paralysis over the left side of his neck.
the plaintiff felt stiffness in his neck and left upper limb numbness and weakness.
He was found to have limitation in lateral rotation of his neck.
left upper limb numbness and weakness
he still has headaches, irritability and depressed mood all of which affects his concentration.
He has insomnia as well as nightmares of the collision with the taxi.
This has given rise to a fear of red-coloured taxis.
Due to the pain and numbness, the plaintiff was unable to carry out his duties as a police constable and has been on sick leave.

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency treatment at Caritas Medical Centre (treated and discharged same day)
Orthopaedic follow-up at Caritas Medical Centre
CT Scan of cervical spine (11 October 2000)
Psychiatric treatment at Department of Psychiatry of Prince of Wales Hospital
treatments_future: psychotherapy (recommended 26 sessions by Dr Singer; court assessed fewer)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: The accident had caused him to give up sporting activities including ten-pin bowling; numbness in his left hand had effectively taken away this and other sporting activities from his enjoyment.
His injuries interfered with his carrying out his duties as a police constable and he could no longer further his career as a policeman leading to early retirement.
